notes: Cooking panel polish from the first evening with v1.34.0. The ingredient and step panels now span the full kiosk width and stack vertically - no more dead space beside a short ingredient list - with ingredients flowing in three columns at a slightly smaller size. Ingredients are now tappable: tap one as you add it to the bowl and it checks off with a green tick and strike-through (the + button still sends it to the grocery list). And the Alexa timer announcement now plays three bell tones before speaking, so it cuts through kitchen noise.
